rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a transferable blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates confidence about TE quality and introduces some ambiguity about expansion/staging relative to the provided 3BA grade.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, semen quality, BMI, prior IVF history, endometrium, and smoking status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well organized, with conclusions generally supported by the case data; minor issues include some overinterpretation of morphology and a somewhat loosely justified implantation range.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines, including single embryo transfer and smoking cessation; minor deviations include imprecise wording around Gardner staging and some speculative comments about progesterone monitoring/fresh-vs-freeze strategy.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, smoking cessation, hydrosalpinx review, and future evaluation, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
